verdict.rationale: Milvus documents its own RBAC that controls user operations at the collection, database and instance levels. That covers roles and per-collection permissions, but the evidence is a single summary sentence, and nothing in the pack mentions API keys or token-based authentication. missing for 10: evidence of API key/token authentication, detailed privilege and role documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration of RBAC enforcement.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce granular access control (API keys, roles, per-collection permissions) on database operations

citations.quote: With RBAC, you can finely control the operations users can perform at the collection, database, and instance levels, enhancing data security.
